jsonld.name: Northwind Automation Hub
jsonld.description: Client onboarding, daily campaign reporting, cost alerts and AI website drafts for a marketing agency, shown as one live 3D world.

routes.title: Northwind Automation Hub | Client onboarding and live ad reporting in 3D
routes.description: Add a client and the hub routes them by service, writes their brief, and reports Google Ads, Meta Ads and SEO every morning. Explore the live numbers as a 3D world.

routes.title: Clients | Northwind Automation Hub
routes.description: Every client the agency manages, with spend, cost per conversion, onboarding status, AI-written brief and open tasks, shown as 3D pillars you can click.

routes.title: Campaign reporting | Northwind Automation Hub
routes.description: Daily spend, conversions and cost per conversion by client and channel, budget pacing, unusual days, a 14-day forecast and AI weekly summaries, with CSV export.

routes.title: Automation runs and alerts | Northwind Automation Hub
routes.description: Every onboarding, reporting and website workflow run with its status and duration, plus the Slack and email messages it sent. Force a failure to watch the error route.

routes.title: AI website drafts | Northwind Automation Hub
routes.description: Five answers in, a one-page website draft out. Rewrite the hero, services, proof or call to action on its own and keep every version.

routes.title: Settings and API keys | Northwind Automation Hub
routes.description: Connect Claude, Airtable, Slack, email, Make and Supabase with your own keys. Keys are encrypted at rest and switch the hub from demo data to your accounts.
